description: Angular component for managing Edge entities in the Thingsboard UI, including form building, update handling, and interaction with EdgeService.

classes.name: EdgeComponent
classes.description: Angular component extending EntityComponent to manage EdgeInfo entities, including form handling, upgrade checks, and copy notifications.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes edgeScope from table config and calls superclass ngOnInit.

methods.name: hideDelete
methods.description: Determines if delete option should be hidden based on table config.

methods.name: isAssignedToCustomer
methods.description: Checks if the EdgeInfo entity is assigned to a customer.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Builds a reactive form for EdgeInfo with validation and default values.

methods.name: updateForm
methods.description: Updates the form with new EdgeInfo data and checks for upgrade availability.

methods.name: updateFormState
methods.description: Disables routingKey and secret fields in the form.

methods.name: onEdgeIdCopied
methods.description: Dispatches notification when Edge ID is copied.

methods.name: onEdgeInfoCopied
methods.description: Dispatches notification when Edge key or secret is copied.

methods.name: generateRoutingKeyAndSecret
methods.description: Generates and patches routingKey and secret if entity is new.
